concerns.text: Functional Requirements FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, and FR-016 are defined in the specification but are absent from the plan’s mapping table; no corresponding plan element or task is listed to exercise these contracts.

The task list ends at T012 and does not include tasks to (a) verify lure‑detail absence (FR‑013), (b) simulate network timeout and exponential backoff (FR‑014), (c) implement fatigue‑mitigation break and trial‑position covariate (FR‑015), or (d) produce the reproducible power‑analysis artifact (FR‑016).
